title: NotesRichDocumentLoomCanonicalIdentityAndJournalRepair
clause: Bind Notes/RichDocument canonical identity to Loom blocks and repair Daily Journal lifecycle on SurrealDB without duplicate note authority.

current_source_discovery: Inspect stable-main WP-012 Notes, RichDocument, editor navigation, Daily Journal and Loom identity/lifecycle seams.
Prove which record owns editable content, which Loom block projects it and how legacy duplicates are detected.
stop_conditions: MT-392 or MT-226 is not accepted.
A migration would choose between duplicates without deterministic evidence or operator-visible conflict handling.

scope.summary: Notes is an operator-facing authoring module and RichDocument is canonical editable content; Loom provides graph, backlink, search and projection connectivity. Daily Journal must resolve to one canonical note per project/date/time-zone contract.
forbidden_paths: Separate mutable Loom copy of note body/content
acceptance_criteria: Each canonical RichDocument/Note has exactly one project-qualified Loom projection identity with typed source relation and repair/version metadata.
Content edits occur only through the Notes/RichDocument authority; Loom backlink/search/graph updates are atomic outbox-driven projections and never independent content copies.
Daily Journal lookup/create is idempotent for project, local date and configured time zone; legacy duplicates are detected, presented and repaired without data loss.
Archive, restore, merge, delete and revision operations preserve source/projection lineage and all incoming/outgoing Loom relations.
Native Notes and Loom routes open the same canonical document and expose projection/repair/conflict state with stable Argus identifiers.
proof_targets: Run real-Surreal canonical identity, concurrent journal creation, timezone boundary, duplicate repair and restart tests.
Run edit-from-Notes/open-from-Loom and edit-from-Loom-route/open-from-Notes native interaction tests.
Run Argus identity/conflict/repair state captures and independent Surreal reread.

same_project_private_resource_cases: A private note and its Loom metadata remain hidden from another project member.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Backlinks, search entries, previews and journal projections inherit note scope.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Open editors, backlinks and projections react to revocation/context switch without stale content.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: Imported/synced notes receive explicit local ownership and never import grants.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Titles, dates, backlink counts, revision counts and conflict states do not reveal denied notes.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.evidence: document/projection/journal create, merge, conflict, repair and denial events
identity, duplicate, projection lag and journal health
editor crash/freeze recovery with canonical document handle

risk_if_missed: Notes and Loom continue to create split identities, breaking backlinks, journals, navigation and future domain connectivity.

risks: Loom silently copies editable note content.

sources: Obsidian Daily Notes and backlinks patterns
research_provenance.selected_approach: Canonical RichDocument content with one typed Loom projection and deterministic project/date/time-zone journal identity.
